Name: Howl Pendragon (Custom NPC)
Author: yirehi
Description:
[center][size=4][font=Comic Sans MS][img]https://parliamentary-purple-muvynljb.edgeone.app/intro.png[/img][/font][/size][/center]
[b][color=#a4c2f4][size=5][font=Verdana]Installation Instructions[/font][/size][/color][/b]
[list=1]
[*][size=3]Install[color=#b4a7d6] [url=https://smapi.io/?utm_source=chatgpt.com][color=#b4a7d6][u]SMAPI[/u][/color][/url][/color][/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915?utm_source=chatgpt.com][color=#b4a7d6][u]Content Patcher[/u][/color][/url][/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Download the mod and unzip the file[/size][/*]
[*][size=3][b]Open the [i]Howl Pendragon[/i] folder[/b][/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Inside, you will find:
   - [CP] Howl Pendragon NPC   
   - [C#] Howl's Systems[/size][/*]
[*][color=#ffffff][size=4]Move [b]both folders separately[/b] into your [b]Stardew Valley/Mods[/b] folder[/size][/color][/*]
[*][size=3]Launch the game using SMAPI [/size][/*]
[/list][center][font=Comic Sans MS][color=#f4f4f4][🐚] [/color][color=#ffffff]This mod adds Howl Pendragon as a romanceable NPC with custom dialogue, schedules, heart events, gifts, original mechanics, and a fully explorable moving castle interior connected through a mysterious door hidden near town.[/color][/font][/center]
[center][font=serif] (There's no Sophie in this made up Stardew Valley AU.  Designed to feel immersive and lore-friendly while keeping Howl’s dramatic personality, charm, and chaotic magic intact. You are Sophie, Sophie is you:].)[/font][/center]

[img width=400,height=80]https://theoretical-tomato-pvdhux2q.edgeone.app/mainfeatures.png[/img]
[color=#6d9eeb]✦ [/color]Fully custom romanceable NPC: Howl Pendragon
[color=#d5a6bd]✦ [/color]Seasonal, weather, and festival dialogue
[color=#6fa8dc]✦[/color] Custom schedules and daily routines
[color=#d5a6bd]✦ [/color]Original heart events
[color=#6d9eeb]✦ [/color]Interactive moving castle interior
[color=#d5a6bd]✦ [/color]Custom Map you can access through howl's magic wheel door:]
[color=#6d9eeb]✦[/color] Custom items, foods and +1 cooking recipe.
[color=#d5a6bd]✦[/color] Marriage support
[color=#6d9eeb]✦ [/color]References inspired by the film while adapting naturally into Stardew Valley.
[center][size=1] If you're lucky, you'll hear townies talking about Howl.(chances are randomized)[/size][/center]
[color=#d5a6bd]✦[/color] Calcifer, Heen(the dog), Markl and Turnip head appearances and other familiar details. (Calcifer and Markl has been added as a support NPC)

[size=5][font=Times New Roman]2 heart event[/font][font=Verdana] : [/font][/size]
[color=#d5a6bd][size=3][font=Verdana]      Enter the Mountain between 21:00PM - 02:00AM[/font][/size][/color]
[spoiler][size=2][font=Trebuchet MS][color=#ffffff]Choices:
- Just home... ([/color][color=#b6d7a8]+25 friendship[/color][color=#ffffff])
- I don't need your help, freak. Get lost. ([/color][color=#ea9999]-100 friendship[/color][color=#ffffff])[/color][/font][/size][/spoiler]
[color=#ffffff][size=5][font=Times New Roman]4 heart event :[/font][/size][/color]
[color=#d5a6bd][font=Verdana]      Enter the Castle between 06:00AM - 12:00PM[/font][/color]
- Howl will ask you to bring him a basket with bacons and eggs inside. You can temporarily get your controls back so find it for him!
[spoiler][size=2]The basket is near the window behind the big table.[/size][/spoiler]
[size=5][font=Times New Roman]6 heart event :[/font][/size]
[color=#d5a6bd][size=3][font=Verdana]     Markl will send you a quest through mail, find the item and enter the castle [b]with[/b] the item.[/font][/size][/color]
[color=#d5a6bd][size=3][font=Verdana]     Enter the Castle at any time.[/font][/size][/color]
[spoiler][color=#ffffff][size=2][font=Arial]The bottle is inside the door's blue mode.[/font][/size][/color][/spoiler]
[size=5][font=Times New Roman]8 heart event:[/font][/size]
[color=#f4f4f4][size=4][font=Verdana] [❗️][/font][/size][/color][color=#d5a6bd][size=3][font=Verdana]  Howl will send you a mail asking a request... Enter the Wizard House after receiving the mail. [/font][/size][/color][color=#ead1dc][size=3][font=Verdana](Decision will be made on this event that you might not wanna miss.^^)[/font][/size][/color]
[spoiler][color=#ffffff][size=2][font=Trebuchet MS]Choices: 
- Honestly...? I kinda miss your blonde hair. ([/font][/size][/color][color=#b6d7a8][size=2][font=Trebuchet MS]+50 friendship[/font][/size][/color][color=#ffffff][size=2][font=Trebuchet MS]) + ([/font][/size][/color][color=#f4cccc][size=2][font=Trebuchet MS]bonus: he'll permanently stick to his blonde hair^^[/font][/size][/color][color=#ffffff][size=2][font=Trebuchet MS])
